Welcome to Kalpanā AI! You can now run 3 Million Tokens directly on any device offline and share full Knowledge Packs (.kp) with your friends.

After hitting 3M tokens, you can continue chatting seamlessly, though Kalpanā may start to gradually fade older context details. Whenever needed, simply export your session as a 6.3 MB .kp Knowledge Pack and start a brand-new 3M token conversation anytime!

100% Offline App & Privacy Guarantee

Air-Gapped Local Execution · Zero Network Connectivity

🌐 Online Web Page Telemetry (Public Web Visit Only)

When visiting the public website on GitHub Pages, basic aggregated analytics record web visits, download counts, and country-level geography solely to display community statistics.

🔒 Explicit 100% Offline Application Architecture

Once downloaded or installed on your device, the app operates as a strictly offline, self-contained application with zero network capability:

  • No Online Re-Connection: Once downloaded, the application cannot connect back online or transmit telemetry.
  • Zero Server Data Transmission: 100% of LLM inference runs locally via WebGPU shaders inside your device hardware.
  • Air-Gapped Privacy: Your prompts, uploaded PDFs, voice audio, and Knowledge Packs (.kp) never leave your device. Nothing is ever logged, recorded, or sent to any server.
